description: The next core skill (docs/jabberwock_representation_design.md): DISCOVER the natural frame from the dynamics, not be given it. The agent's design: 'the discovered axes are the principal directions of motion.' For a single dominant motion the principal direction IS the observed velocity — which the agent already perceives (drow, dcol). So the discovered along-axis = its own motion vector, and the perpendicular = its orthogonal; rotating the position into that frame (Dot-over-axes, the agent's primitive) DECOUPLES the motion: along-axis carries all of it, the perpendicular is INVARIANT. The frame is read off the agent's own surprise/motion, never provided. (Unnormalised axes still decouple; the full eigen-frame of the action_delta + residual covariance is the general form for multi-directional dynamics.)

microtheory.name: nd_basis_discovery
microtheory.description: the natural axis = the direction I observe myself moving (the principal motion direction); rotate into it and the motion decouples — discovered, not given.

rules.name: discover_natural_frame
rules.comment: Discover the natural frame from the observed motion: along-axis = the velocity vector [drow, dcol] (the principal direction of motion the agent sees); perp-axis = its orthogonal [-dcol, drow]. Then rotate the position into that frame by Dot-over-axes: pos_along = pos.along, pos_perp = pos.perp. Fires only when the region is actually moving (squared speed > 0). For diagonal motion this makes pos_perp constant (invariant) and pos_along carry the motion — the agent found the world's own coordinate from its own dynamics, no basis handed to it.
